δάκρυσ: δάκρυ — tear; neut. dat. pl., elided (δάκρυσ’ = δάκρυσι)

δουρικλειτὸν: δουρικλειτός — famed for the spear; masc. acc. sg., epithet of Menelaus in apposition

σήμερον: σήμερον — today, this day; adv. (Attic τήμερον)
σκηπτόμενον: σκήπτομαι — lean on, support oneself on; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’leaning (on a staff)’

στονόεσσα: στονόεις — full of groaning, mournful; adj., fem. nom. sg., epic -όεσσα
τετμημένον: τέμνω — cut; perf. pass. part. neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’cut, hewn’

χαλεπαὶ: χαλεπός — hard, harsh, grievous; adj., fem. nom. pl.
χρηΐζων: χρηΐζω — need, want, have need of; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic χρῄζων): ’needing’
χρόνιον: χρόνιος — after a long time, long-absent; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἐλθόντα: ’after a long time’

ἐκόμιζε: κομίζω — care for, take care of, convey; impf. 3 sg.: ’cared for’

ἐτέρφθητε: τέρπω — delight; pass. take pleasure, enjoy; aor. 2 pl. pass., + dat.: ’you have taken your pleasure’
ἐφρασάμην: φράζω — point out; mid. notice, observe; aor. 1 sg. mid.: ’I noticed’
ἐϋκτιμένῃ: ἐΰκτιμένος — well-built, well-founded; adj., fem. dat. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὐ-), of Lesbos
ἐϋσσέλμου: ἐΰσσελμος — with good benches, well-benched; adj., fem. gen. sg., epithet of a ship, epic doubled -σσ-
ἔρχεσθε: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’go, come’
ἕρπων: ἕρπω — creep, crawl, go slowly; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’creeping’
ἕσπερα: ἕσπερος — of evening; neut. pl. used as a noun, ’evening’; acc. pl. after ποτί: ’toward evening’
ἕστο: ἕννυμι — clothe; mid. put on, wear; plpf. 3 sg. mid., epic, + acc.: ’he was wearing, he had put on’
ἱέρευον: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; impf. 1 sg. or 3 pl.: ’they were sacrificing’
ἵρευον: ἱρεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; impf. 1 sg. or 3 pl., epic by-form of ἱερεύω: ’they were sacrificing’
ὁμοκλαί: ὁμοκλή — rebuke, threatening cry, reproof; fem. nom. pl.
ὄϊς: ὄϊς — sheep; common gender (masc. or fem.), acc. pl., epic ὄϊς (= Attic οἶς): ’sheep’
ὅττευ: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; also indirect interrogative ’who, what’; gen. sg., epic ὅττευ (= Attic ὅτου), object genitive after χρηΐζων: ’in need of what’
ὑπερώϊον: ὑπερῷον — upper room, upper storey; neut. acc. sg., epic ὑπερώϊον (= Attic ὑπερῷον)
ὠτρύνοντ: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; mid. hasten; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented ὠ-, elided (ὠτρύνοντ’ = ὠτρύνοντο): ’were hastening’
ᾠχόμεθ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 1 pl., augmented ᾠ-, elided (ᾠχόμεθ’ = ᾠχόμεθα): ’we went’
ᾤχεθ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented ᾤ-, elided with τ > θ before a rough breathing (ᾤχεθ’ = ᾤχετο): ’he went off’
ῥίγιον: ῥίγιον — colder, harsher, worse (cf. ῥῖγος ’cold’); comparative adj., neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’colder’
ῥυτῆρα: ῥυτήρ — protector, guardian (from ῥύομαι); masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’as protector’
ῥύατ: ῥύομαι — protect, guard; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic ῥύατο, elided (ῥύατ’ = ῥύατο; Attic ἐρρύοντο): ’they guarded’
